description: Proves (or refutes) that a {path,digest} pair was in a disclosure manifest's room (DATAROOM-1-BUILD-SPEC.md §DR-4) -- worker-side mirror of tools/547-disclosure-manifest-verifier.html's single-file inclusion check. Recomputes the manifest's Merkle root over its entries[], builds the inclusion proof path for the target entry, and reapplies it to confirm it reduces to the claimed merkle_root. Absence is only provable against the exact manifest version passed in.

digest.description: sha256:-prefixed digest of the file to prove.

manifest.description: The disclosure manifest to check against (needs entries[] + merkle_root).

path.description: Path of the entry to prove.

name: verify_disclosure_inclusion
title: Verify Merkle inclusion in a disclosure manifest
